translation: One should use manual technique, press the sinews and set the bone to restore it to its position, apply Wanling Gao (Myriad-Efficacy Plaster, 萬靈膏), wrap it in a bamboo curtain (竹簾), and then bind it with white cloth; first take Zhenggu Zijin Dan (Bone-Setting Purple-Gold Pill, 正骨紫金丹), and then take Jianbu Huqian Wan (Agile-Steps Tiger-Crouching Pill, 健步虎潛丸). <ins>Wanling Gao</ins> <ins>Zhenggu Zijin Dan</ins> (both seen in the injury of the vertex bone) <ins>Jianbu Huqian Wan</ins> (Agile-Steps Tiger-Crouching Pill, 健步虎潛丸) (seen in the injury of the hip bone).
